items.name: hero-night
items.prompt: Night roadside avenue after rain, light trails, cobalt haze, streetlights, power lines; left half dark for headline, right third open sky. Style anchor: cinematic night photography for a premium Detroit cannabis showroom brand campaign; no text, signs, logos or people.

items.name: jars-counter
items.prompt: Three blank glass apothecary jars of frosty cannabis buds on a glossy deep-navy counter with an electric-blue LED strip; near-black background; left third dark for text. Same style anchor.

items.name: concentrates
items.prompt: Macro still life: amber glass-like concentrate shards and an open glass jar of golden budder on black glass, blue rim light. Same style anchor.

items.name: vapes-more
items.prompt: Blank vape cartridge, blank amber tincture dropper bottle and blank navy can on glossy navy glass with an LED line beneath. Same style anchor.

items.name: box-spotlight
items.prompt: Three blank glass jars of top-shelf buds on black velvet under one spotlight, cool-white marquee bulb bokeh far behind, no gold; upper half dark for a heading. Same style anchor.

items.name: neon-abstract
items.prompt: Abstract royal-blue and hot-pink neon tube curves on a black wall reflected on a wet surface; no letters. Same style anchor.

items.name: rainbow-reflections
items.prompt: Wet asphalt at night with blurred rainbow-coloured reflections in puddles; no buildings or light sources in frame; upper half dark. Same style anchor.

items.name: bulb-bokeh
items.prompt: Diagonal row of warm-white marquee bulbs in a black panel, very shallow focus, bokeh; right half dark. Same style anchor.

items.name: showroom-glow
items.prompt: Abstract soft-focus bright white glossy showroom with electric-blue LED lines reflected on white surfaces; no products, no people.

items.name: hero-night-b
items.prompt: Fix round for hero-night (pseudo-text signs): empty multi-lane avenue at night after rain, light trails, streetlights receding right, haze, power lines; only dark empty land and a faint distant city glow; no buildings, shops, illuminated signs or billboards; left half dark for text. Same style anchor.

items.prompt: Second variant of the hero-night fix round (identical prompt, no seed).
